description: Composite figure mixing TEM micrographs with a constitutive-model plot; the caption frames the whole group as "TEM analysis of microstructure of soft domain and hard domain". (a) comprises three bright-field TEM micrographs with 1 µm scale bars taken from AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T before deformation, each annotated with yellow phase labels F, FM, B and TM; dashed yellow ellipses outline a B/TM region and white parallel line segments denote carbide lamellae inside B. Blue and red arrows connect the labelled regions, decoded by a colour legend as R (blue) and Δh (red), with Carbide (white). The third micrograph carries the printed header "AN850-T". (b) is a dark-field TEM image of AN850-T (500 nm scale bar) with bright elongated features on a dark matrix, two picked out by yellow triangles. Further bright-field images at 300 nm and 500 nm show dislocation structures in ferrite marked by yellow T-shaped symbols and a bright ferrite grain beside regions labelled FM. (e) is three stacked-area plots of true stress (MPa) versus true strain, labelled σ_B, f_Fσ_F, f_BTM σ_BTM, f_RAσ_RA, f_FMσ_FM and f_DIMσ_DIM, with open squares and a red dashed model fit; the strain axis extends to ~0.19 for AN750-T but only ~0.06 for AN800-T and AN850-T. Together the panels argue that GND accumulation at soft/hard-domain boundaries generates back stress and controls phase-by-phase strength contributions.

observations.observation: Panel (a) consists of three bright-field TEM micrographs with 1 µm scale bars, labelled F, FM, B and TM, in which yellow dashed ellipses outline a B/TM region and white parallel line segments inside B denote carbide lamellae.
In panel (a) blue and red arrows connect the labelled phase regions, and a colour legend decodes blue as R and red as Δh with a white line for Carbide.
The third TEM image in panel (a) carries the printed header 'AN850-T'.
Panel (b) is a dark-field TEM image with a 500 nm scale bar, showing bright elongated features on a near-black matrix with two features marked by yellow triangles.
The caption identifies (a) as internal characteristics and dislocation distribution of AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, (b) as a dark-field image of AN850-T and (d) as a bright-field image of AN850-T.

Panel (e) is three stacked-area plots of true stress (MPa) versus true strain, annotated σ_B, f_Fσ_F, f_BTMσ_BTM, f_RAσ_RA, f_FMσ_FM and f_DIMσ_DIM, with open squares and a red dashed line representing experiment and model fit respectively.
The true-strain axis of the AN750-T plot extends to about 0.19, whereas the AN800-T and AN850-T plots stop at about 0.06, indicating much earlier necking in the higher-temperature anneals.
The caption states that GNDs are released in the soft domain and accumulate at the soft/hard-domain boundary, generating back stress opposed to the applied stress.
The citing text reports that the back-stress strengthening contribution from GNDs at necking strain is 236, 291 and 254 MPa for AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T respectively.
The citing text states that the strength contribution of B/TM is higher than the other phases, reaching 23%, 41% and 54% of the flow stress at necking strain for AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T.
The citing text explains that the average thickness of the unit heterogeneous layer Δh was obtained by averaging several TEM structures using the method shown in Fig. 10(a).
The 300 nm bright-field images show ferrite dislocation cell/vein structures annotated with yellow T-shaped symbols; no numeric value is printed on these panels.

The caption lists the panel sequence as (a) internal characteristics and dislocation distribution, (c) release of GNDs in soft domain, (b) dark-field of AN850-T, (d) bright-field of AN850-T and (e) constitutive relation fitting of phases.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph, 1 µm scale bar. Yellow-dashed ellipses mark a TM domain (upper) and a B domain (lower) containing white parallel carbide segments; yellow labels F, FM, B, TM. Blue (R) and red (Δh) arrows link the phase regions.
Bright-field TEM micrograph, 1 µm scale bar, same F / FM / B / TM labelling and blue/red arrow annotation as the first image.
Bright-field TEM micrograph with printed header 'AN850-T', 1 µm scale bar, showing a large bright FM region and a dashed-ellipse B domain with white carbide segments, plus F, TM labels and arrows.
Dark-field TEM image of AN850-T, 500 nm scale bar. Predominantly dark field with bright elongated/streaky features; two features indicated by yellow triangles.

Two side-by-side bright-field TEM images (300 nm scale bars) of ferrite with dislocation cell/vein structure; yellow T-shaped symbols mark features. A colour key at the bottom reads R (blue), Δh (red), Carbide (white).
Bright-field TEM image, 300 nm scale bar, showing a ferrite grain with dislocation networks and yellow T-shaped markers.
Bright-field TEM image, 500 nm scale bar, with a bright ferrite grain adjacent to darker regions labelled FM (twice); no numeric values printed.

Stacked-area plot of true stress (MPa, 0–1500) vs true strain (0.01 to ~0.19). Layers from bottom: f_DIMσ_DIM (red), f_RAσ_RA and f_FMσ_FM (yellow), f_BTMσ_BTM (green), f_Fσ_F (purple), σ_B (grey). Open squares (experiment) and red dashed line (model fit).
Same stacked-area style for AN800-T, true strain 0.01 to ~0.06. Large green f_BTMσ_BTM band; red arrows point into f_DIMσ_DIM, f_RAσ_RA and f_FMσ_FM layers.
Same stacked-area style for AN850-T, true strain 0.01 to ~0.058, with the same six labelled contributions and square/dashed-line model-vs-experiment overlay.

unreadable_items: panel letters (a)-(e) are not printed on the images; the panel-to-content assignment is inferred from the caption and its order is not fully self-consistent
some small annotation/legend text and dislocation detail in the 300 nm and 500 nm panels is low-contrast and only partially readable
the exact strain endpoint values of the AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T plot axes are only readable to the printed tick labels (0.01, 0.04, 0.07, 0.10, 0.13, 0.16, 0.19 for AN750-T)
